title: Not as pictured
text:
Not as pictured. First off, these are very nice bookends. They feel heavy and sturdy. The construction is good and I like the price. The white wash on them is nice and works great for an industrial or farmhouse decor. I have happy with the overall style of them.

What I am not happy with is what I was sent. The picture very clearly shows one side has an elbow pipe and the other has a super cool faucet! I received two elbow pipe pieces. Again, I do like them, but this is not what was advertised. I selected these specifically for the faucet aspect as I hadn’t seen it before. Very disappointed that they do not have accurate photos or descriptions on their listing.

product_metadata.title: Deconoor Countryside Wooden Bookend for Heavy Books, Rustic Bookrest with Modern Realistic Industrial Metal Piping for Desktop, Shelf Decor, Tabletop, Bookends for Home, Office, Study Table Décor
features: UNIQUE DESIGN: This rustic bookend is beautifully designed to highlight your home and office décor. It can be displayed as tabletop on desktop table, centre table, bookshelf, study table etc. It is made of good quality of wood and realistic looking industrial tap and gauge design.

FEATURES: It has antique torched finish on wood. The combination of industrial metal tap and gauge with wood, complements rustic and steampunk decor. It is dual sided stand which can be used together or just with one sided display.

MULTIFUNCTIONAL PRODUCT: It can be used as a decorative piece in your garden, arrange your magazines in spa and sauna room. Ideal for organizing your books, files, DVDs, old journals, or anything on your shelves in your workspace, home, office, bookshop, or school.

IDEAL FOR GIFTING: You can secure your books and important documents with this book stopper. It is a great gifting choice for book lovers on important events like graduation party, housewarming, anniversary, retirement party, store and office opening, Christmas, easter, thanksgiving, new year etc.
DIMENSION: It has a compact L shaped design, with dimension of 6.5 inches length, 6.5 inches height and 4 inches width, ideal for any space.
